hypothesis: Joint, capability-balanced supervision of all fourteen declared English capabilities in the same unchanged LayerCake core will prevent the catastrophic forgetting measured in v17 while retaining its natural realization gains.

measured_bottleneck.interpretation: The four-capability artifact successfully acquired natural realization quality but omitted the other ten declared English capabilities from teacher supervision, allowing shared-core catastrophic forgetting.

candidate_lock.training_parent: unchanged v6 broad14 parent, not v17 and not a symbolic-runtime successor
candidate_lock.sampling_invariant: Exactly one example from each of fourteen capabilities per successful step; every capability receives 10,575 observations and every one of the 43,108 immutable records is seen at least once.
candidate_lock.only_controlled_change_vs_v17: Teacher supervision changes from a four-capability corpus to the already-extracted fourteen-capability union and capability-balanced joint optimization; the parent, architecture, tokenizer, sequence ceiling, learning rates, recovery schedule, general replay, and base decoder remain unchanged.

hardware_policy.cpu_role: Exact deployed LayerCake inference, TTFO, throughput, active-memory, identity, and physical-sparse certification only.

validation_order: Require all 43,108 immutable records, all fourteen capabilities, and every successful optimizer step to be accounted from CUDA training metadata.
Export the exact teacher-free checkpoint with the unchanged generic maximum-identical-token-run overlay.
Reverify checkpoint identity, canonical ABI, source absence, and physical sparse execution.
Run the locked 1,400-observation broad14 validation first on native CPU and require every corrected functional, retention, route, and zero-collapse gate.
Only if broad14 passes, run all 1,000 deep scale validation prompts on native CPU and require zero collapse and every functional gate.
Only if both automatic suites pass, run the unchanged 112-prompt blinded paired Qwen judge on CUDA and require every strict teacher-relative gate.
Only then run the disclosed natural generalization audit, corrected Phase-2 suite, repeated CPU benchmark, three paired seeds or fresh hosts, package identity, isolation, and untouched final split.
decision_rule: Reject the single integrated candidate on any locked gate. Do not access final-test data, change decoder thresholds, add symbolic or prompt-specific repairs, or launch a nearby weighting sweep. A failure must be preserved and used to select a materially different measured architecture.
claim_boundary: This protocol tests joint acquisition and retention on GPU. It does not weaken the requirement that the same final teacher-free LayerCake clear every CPU inference, quality, identity, isolation, memory, TTFO, and speed gate.
